teaches strategy at the undergraduate and graduate level at Washington University in St. Louis. His research extensively utilizes large datasets from the worlds of business, politics, and governance. He has released six books, edited two, and published over 70 papers. He is a regularly-cited expert, an official Fellow of the Strategic Management Society (SMS), and an invited member of the editorial boards of the Strategic Management Journal, Journal of Management, Organization Science, and other key strategy management journals. He has appeared on the Bloomberg Business Network multiple times to discuss proactive corporate governance and how strategic issues can arise in any type of organization. Lamar is also a highly sought-after public speaker, having delivered the keynote address at the 50th anniversary of the ICIS conference, hosted by the University of Sydney.
